titlePlain: Adding a Snapshot for Slowly Changing
subtitle: Recording history a plain SELECT can never show

caption: Real dbt snapshot syntax, timestamp strategy.

steps.label: unique_key
steps.sub: Tracks the same real customer across runs

steps.label: dbt_valid_from/to
steps.sub: Added automatically, marking each version's window

code:
dbt snapshot

select customer_id, status, dbt_valid_from, dbt_valid_to
from snapshots.customer_status_snapshot
where customer_id = 42
order by dbt_valid_from;
caption: A real, queryable status history for one customer.
